mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals economic stress that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1400 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates simultaneous weakening in consumer demand and supply chain stress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 1400 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) over the prior quarter signals expanding economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and retail sales (RSAFS) decline below 650,000, it indicates simultaneous supply contraction and demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 650000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% and HOUST growth > 1.0% in 3 months), housing market strength (HOUST) signals sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% and HOUST growth exceeds 1.0%.
